fusions.name: Reaping Sweep
fusions.desc: Swings a curved link around you, dealing 10 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles. You heal for 20% of the damage dealt. Costs 5% of your maximum health.

fusions.name: Hooked Reap
fusions.desc: You rush to the target and strike, dealing 14 damage and leaving it [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Gathered In
fusions.desc: Restores 16 health to you. Its healing rises +8% for every 10% of your health already gone (max +40%).

fusions.name: Ripe for the Cut
fusions.desc: Against enemies below half health, you deal 12% more damage.
